_about: Phoenix Mesh (Nebula). No secrets in this file — certs/keys live in the vault. Edit, then: python sector3/mesh/phoenix_net.py sign <host>; config/install.

pbmiii.note: HP - home Starlink router 192.168.1.190. Starlink = CGNAT and filters inbound IPv6, so it can't be a lighthouse; it dials out to awslh and relays for the Compaq on the home side

compaq.note: home server — reaches the mesh through pbmiii

awslh.note: AWS Lightsail us-east-1 nano ($5/mo), static IPv4 44.195.192.107 + IPv6 - always-reachable lighthouse + relay (works through Starlink CGNAT and hotel NAT)
